Corten steel privacy screen panel - laser profile-cut from quality 3 mm weathering steel.

Ideal for decks, fences, courtyards and boundary screening. Supplied raw so it develops a natural protective rust patina outdoors.

NZ made. Custom sizes available. Mounting options by quote.
